# Review checklist

## Scientific correctness

- [ ] Physics assumptions are documented
- [ ] Physical units are explicit
- [ ] Numerical approximations are justified
- [ ] Validation strategy is adequate

## Code quality

- [ ] Code is readable
- [ ] Functions are reasonably sized
- [ ] No obvious duplication

## Documentation

- [ ] Module docstrings present
- [ ] Public functions have docstrings
- [ ] New functionality documented

## Testing

- [ ] check Continuous Integration pytest is green
- [ ] New functionality has tests
- [ ] Edge cases are covered

## Git hygiene

- [ ] Branch is up-to-date with main
- [ ] No unnecessary commits
- [ ] Notebook outputs removed
- [ ] Large files not accidentally committed

## Reproducibility

- [ ] Dependencies documented
- [ ] Results can be reproduced
